::::: content
I just found out that [SlideShare](http://www.slideshare.net/) allows you to upload portrait-oriented documents (like articles and handouts) as well as landscape (presentations). That's good for me, since I use SlideShare a lot for presentations but haven't been as good at sharing worksheets and their solutions. I've used [scribd](http://www.scribd.com/people/view/94344-leingang) for that stuff but for whatever reason I haven't been as diligent at uploading. One-stop shopping will help.

Here's an embed of a SlideShare-hosted worksheet:
